49 SOM LAL A v. VIJAY LAXMI & ORS. (Civil Appeal No. 5104 of 2006) MARCH 14, 2008 B r (A.K. MATHUR AND ALTAMAS KABIR, JJ.) Punjab State Election Commission Act, 1994 (Act 19 of 1994): ss. 11 (f) and (g) - Panchayat Election - Election of c Sarpanch - Disqualifications - Office of profit - in s. 11 would prevail and not those mentioned fn s. 208 of Act 9 D of 1994 which are inconsistent to s. 11 of Act 19of1994 - Since returned candidate did not incur disqualification. ~s per sub- sections (f) and (g) of s.11, Election Tribunal and High Court wrongly held him to be disqualified
